{{Quote|A Compact Assault Vehicle doesn't necessarily signal the presence of an Imperial base. It probably means just the opposite. The Empire uses these one troop vehicles on undeveloped worlds that aren't occupied territory. One trooper in a CAV can control a lot of territory.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="MMY">''[[Mission from Mount Yoda]]''</ref>}}
The '''Compact Assault Vehicle/Wheeled PX-10''' was a single-[[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Surface Assault Vehicle]] manufactured by [[Nen-Carvon]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Imperial_CAV.jpg|thumb|left|Side view of the PX-10]]
The Compact Assault Vehicle/Wheeled PX-10 was a tracked combat assault vehicle controlled by a single trooper.<ref name="ISB" /> Measuring 5.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="ISB2" /> the vehicle was fast and well armored,<ref name="ISB" /> capable of reaching speeds of 260 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="ISB2" /> An extensive [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] and communications package allowed the PX-10 to drive itself, allowing the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] to man the blaster cannon and focus on combat operations. However, the complex computer systems employed by the PX-10 were vulnerable to [[Jamming beam/Legends|jamming]]. The jamming caused the input from the sensors to confuse the computers, rendering the programs governing the automated pilot assistance to not function.<ref name="ISB" />

Armed with a single [[Mk 4e/S medium blaster cannon]],<ref name="MBC" /> the PX-10 transformed a single soldier into a mobile armored assault force.<ref name="ISB" /> Able to carry one hundred [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo and enough consumables to last two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]],<ref name="TUR" /> the PX-10 was an equal combination of weapon and fort.<ref name="ISB" /> Restricted to military sale, PX-10s could be bought for 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on the black market.<ref name="TUR" />

==History==
The PX-10 was developed in response to the problem of spreading the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] resources too thinly across all the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] it controlled. Some remote planets were too insignificant to the Empire to warrant the deployment of a full occupational force, but still needed a significant Imperial presence. Armed with the PX-10, a single trooper was capable of generating the firepower of an entire [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. A number of PX-10 equipped troopers were able to control and hold a vast amount of territory, as long as the opposition did not have firepower to match, or overcome, the local Imperial force.<ref name="ISB" /> The Empire also used them as a surveillance tool, as well as to deny the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] from controlling assets due to a lack of Imperial presence. Nonetheless, Alliance forces soon came to recognize that the presence of a PX-10 signaled a reduced Imperial presence.<ref name="TUR" />

Imperial doctrine called for PX-10 drivers to never leave their vehicles. Due to the known jamming issue with the onboard computers, PX-10s were less useful against high-tech opponents who knew how to exploit the PX-10's flaw, but were effective on primitive planets throughout the Empire.<ref name="ISB" /> The PX-10's vulnerability to sensor jamming, coupled with its limited weapons complement, meant that it never gained much traction with other organizations other than the Empire.<ref name="TUR" />

[[File:ISTCAV.png|thumb|right|Luke Skywalker, Han Solo, Chewbacca, and Ken inspect an abandoned PX-10]]
Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Empire employed PX-10s operated by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] pilots for patrol and surveillance on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Acherin]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ferus Olin]], and [[Raina Quill]], a member of the Acherin resistance, encountered several while attempting to reach the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Eluthan]].<ref name="DW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;along with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|Jedi Prince]] [[Ken]]&mdash;discovered an abandoned PX-10 on bluff overlooking a beach on the picturesque planet [[Z'trop]]. Skywalker and Solo deactivated the vehicle's weapon systems.<ref name="MMY" />

The [[Hydrospeare Corporation]] developed an aquatic modification of the PX-10 known as the [[Aquadon CAVa 400]]. Fitted with lateral and stern [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] in addition to treads, the Aquadon CAVa 400 was a submersible assault vehicle that was instrumental in the [[Kath subjugation]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
